notes.title: Performance & Lighting Update
notes.notes: We improved the lighting for better performance and cleaned up a few map issues.  Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Various Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where lobbies were being split by both language and region. Lobbies are now matched by region only, allowing more players to connect together.

Added med kits to more maps 

Cleaned up Wizard's Wacky World Pet Card Achievements

Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by recent update.

The following have been resolved:

- Stuck on loading screen
- Small map changes
- Players kicked to the lobby on restart


If you continue to encounter bugs, please report in the Steam community or our Discord.[url=https://discord.gg/AR9CDZS6Fj]Here[/url].
